summary: @or-sdk/auth preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall script (setup.mjs) is obfuscated with hex-scrambled identifiers and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes that freshly downloaded alternate runtime (via execFileSync) against a sibling file math_init.js shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a 727KB file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing obfuscator.io-style string-array rotator plus a multi-thousand-entry mixed number/string array, i.e. heavily obfuscated code. The package is advertised as an authentication SDK; pulling a second language runtime at install time solely to execute an obfuscated 727KB blob under it does not match that purpose and functions as an alternate-runtime dropper that bypasses Node-based scanning of the actual executed code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
